note: Known-good serving rates per rung. A rung below 80% of baseline is degraded, not noisy -- 0.80 is chosen to catch the ~22% loss serve-arc.cmd attributes to a partial VRAM spill, the quietest real degradation this box produces. Re-baseline ONLY after verifying the rung by other means (placement via ff_census.py, then a deliberate A/B). A burst baseline is invalid on a rung that decays under sustained load -- measure at plateau.
